years_since_diagnosis.evidence: Crohn's diagnosis came late - age 33. ... Clock is ticking at 36.

occupation.evidence: Chalked up to busy career in finance.

location.evidence: Colonoscopy showed skip lesions throughout colon, classic Crohn's pattern.

severity.evidence: Finally, hospitalization for severe dehydration and weight loss forced the issue. ... Another hospitalization convinced me. Started Entyvio infusions.

disease_control.evidence: Worked well for a year, then started developing joint pain. ... Entyvio losing effectiveness.

treatments.evidence: Started conservatively with mesalamine. Minimal improvement.
Added prednisone for flare control. The mood swings were horrible. Snapped at colleagues, cried in bathroom. Not sustainable in high-pressure job.
Moved to azathioprine. Three months in, liver enzymes spiked. Had to stop.
Tried dietary modifications instead - SCD diet, supplements, acupuncture. Marginal improvement but not enough.
Started Entyvio infusions. ... Worked well for a year, then started developing joint pain. ... Entyvio losing effectiveness.
Added methotrexate for RA, which ironically might help Crohn's too. Side effects are rough - hair thinning, mouth sores, constant nausea. But the joint pain is manageable now.

encounters.evidence: Spent years being told IBS, stress, anxiety.
Finally, hospitalization for severe dehydration and weight loss forced the issue.
Colonoscopy showed skip lesions throughout colon, classic Crohn's pattern. Started conservatively with mesalamine. ... Doctor recommended biologics but I resisted.

status.evidence: Started Entyvio infusions. ... Entyvio losing effectiveness. Looking into Stelara as next option.

barriers.evidence: Doctor recommended biologics but I resisted. Needle phobia since childhood. The thought of regular injections paralyzed me.
